# goslop text fixture — close then raise on MaxRetryError arm vs close then
# continue on the retry arm: one release per path (niquests wasi adapter FP)
lang: python
file: wasi_retry.py
---
def send(request, retries):
    while True:
        response = _send_once(request)
        if retries.is_retry(response.status_code):
            try:
                retries = retries.increment(response=response)
            except MaxRetryError:
                if retries.raise_on_status:
                    response.close()
                    raise
                return response
            response.close()
            retries.sleep()
            continue
        return response
